data.name: Ansariyah
data.gender_notes: Ansariyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman who supports and follows the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The name Ansariyah carries the meaning “Supporter of the Messenger” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ansariyah usually hope their child will grow to embody supporter of the messenger and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A woman who is devoted to the Prophet Muhammad and strives to follow his teachings
data.etymology: Ansariyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Supporter of the Messenger.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ansariyah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: أنصارية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من أنصار، يعني مؤيدة ومساندة
in_arabic.long_meaning: الأنصارية هي اسم علم مؤنث عربي، مشتق من كلمة 'أنصار' التي تعني المساندين والمؤيدين للنبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم. تحمل هذه الكلمة معنى العون والمساندة، وتدل على الشخصية التي تتميز بالدعم والمساعدة للآخرين. في السياق الإسلامي، الأنصار كانوا الصحابة الذين ساعدوا المهاجرين في المدينة المنورة.

in_english.name: Ansariyah
in_english.long_meaning: Ansariyah is a feminine given name derived from the Arabic term 'Ansar,' which refers to the supporters and helpers of the Prophet Muhammad in Medina. The name embodies the qualities of being supportive, helpful, and caring. In Islamic tradition, the Ansar were the companions of the Prophet who provided assistance and shelter to the Muhajireen (migrants) in Medina. The name Ansariyah reflects a personality that is known for their supportive nature and willingness to help others.

pronunciation.urdu: انصاریہ کا تلفظ ان سا ری اے ہے

data.cultural_impact: The name Ansariyah carries a significant cultural impact as it is a reminder of the early Muslim community who lived in Madinah, known as the Ansar, or "helpers". These were the local residents of Madinah who welcomed and supported the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and his Companions when they migrated to the city. The name Ansariyah is a way to honor and remember their unwavering support, dedication, and sacrifice. It embodies the spirit of brotherhood, unity, and solidarity among Muslims, emphasizing the importance of helping and supporting one another.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ansariyah holds a deep spiritual significance as it symbolizes the commitment and devotion of a Muslim woman to uphold the teachings and values of Islam as practiced by the early Muslim community, the Sahabah (companions) of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). It reflects the inner quality of being a supportive and caring wife, mother, or sister in the Muslim community. The woman with the name Ansariyah is encouraged to embody the virtues of faith, patience, kindness, and generosity, as exemplified by the Ansar women during the time of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). Furthermore, the name Ansariyah signifies a connection to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and his Sahabah (companions), inspiring the bearer of the name to seek their guidance and strive for closeness to Allah (subhanahu wa ta'ala), the Creator and Sustainer of all things.
